packet_dag.terminal_condition: Rabbi/provider CRM and mailbox views show role-facing CRM actions and no Super Admin configuration diagnostics.

title: Rabbi CRM Role View Cleanup

reasons: Operator reported that Rabbi could not find the CRM or email storage.
Operator identified Super Admin configuration diagnostics leaking into a Rabbi role surface.
The work touches email/CRM actions and must preserve send/write guardrails.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time Rabbi provider portal CRM and mailbox
likely_external_provider_blockers: Live outbound email remains approval-gated and is not enabled by this packet.
Webhook/provider setup diagnostics remain Super Admin-only and are not displayed in the Rabbi role view.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Patch provider.html review/view-as Rabbi CRM and mailbox surfaces, then verify with focused browser tests.

operator_intent_summary: Make the Rabbi/provider CRM and mailbox feel like a normal role-facing workspace with clear actions, while keeping configured/not configured/setup/readiness diagnostics in Super Admin only.
raw_quotes: I was not able to even see the actual rabbis CRM
I didn't see any clean CRM with like you know send a message send an email
all I see is a bunch of like random information about what's configured not configured
that information I've already told you before should not appear anywhere other than super admin

decisions_captured.decision: Remove Super Admin readiness/configuration panels from the Rabbi review/view-as navigation instead of merely relabeling them.
Keep live outbound email governed by existing server-side send approval; the Rabbi role view may show draft/compose routes but cannot silently enable sends.

out_of_scope: No live email, WhatsApp, SMS, Telegram, payment, access, DNS, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive, or external CRM write is approved.
No provider password, secret, webhook, API token, or raw private message body is exposed.
No broader parent/student visual redesign is implemented in this packet.
No Super Admin diagnostics are deleted; they are only kept out of the Rabbi/provider role surface.

inspection_targets: providerSections review/view-as branch includes Business and Configuration panels.
Mailbox readiness pills expose webhook/runtime/provider setup labels.
CRM review branch shows pipelines and portal navigation but no clear contact/action workspace.
Integration/commercial/access panels expose readiness decisions that belong in Super Admin.
known_blockers: Live outbound sends remain gated outside this packet.

expanded_phrases.clean: Rabbi role surfaces must show a small set of predictable panels with role-facing labels, stable spacing, and no internal setup diagnostics.
expanded_phrases.CRM: A contact and conversation workspace showing parent/student/support records plus actions to open inbox, draft a message, and review email templates.
expanded_phrases.configured: Provider setup/readiness language belongs only in Super Admin or setup-specific surfaces, not Rabbi role navigation.
expanded_phrases.not configured: Do not show negative integration setup status in the Rabbi role view; show role-safe action states instead.
expanded_phrases.send a message: Visible message actions must route to safe draft/review surfaces or existing guarded handlers.
expanded_phrases.send an email: Visible email actions must route to the mailbox/email preview or existing guarded composer path; no silent live send.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use first-party BNA CRM/mailbox surfaces, not GHL/LeadConnector runtime.

requirements.statement: Rabbi/provider CRM view must show a clear contact/conversation workspace with role-safe actions.
requirements.expected_result: CRM section shows parent, student, support/private question cues, and buttons/links for mailbox, email preview, parent view, student view, and classroom.
acceptance_criteria: CRM panel contains Send message or Draft message language tied to safe role actions.
CRM panel contains Send email or Email preview action tied to mailbox/email preview.
CRM panel does not show setup/readiness diagnostics.

requirements.statement: Rabbi/provider mailbox view must explain where One Time emails live without exposing webhook/runtime setup labels.
requirements.expected_result: Mailbox section shows info@onetimeonetime.com, sample inbox/thread state, search/open thread/save draft actions, and no configured/not configured/setup labels.
acceptance_criteria: No visible webhook/runtime readiness labels in Rabbi review/view-as mailbox.
No Bulk email locked label in Rabbi role view.
Existing server-side mailbox send approval remains in place.

requirements.statement: Rabbi/provider navigation must remove Super Admin Business/Configuration diagnostics.
requirements.expected_result: One Time review/view-as navigation shows Dashboard, CRM, Mailbox, Communications, Content, Live Class, Library, Users, Badges, and Support only.
acceptance_criteria: Payments, Integrations, and Access Checklist are not selectable in Rabbi review/view-as navigation.
section=integrations, section=commercial, and section=access fall back to Overview.
Super Admin configuration surfaces remain out of scope for this route.

requirements.statement: Focused tests must prove the cleanup across desktop and mobile.
requirements.expected_result: Browser tests verify CRM/mailbox text, forbidden diagnostics, section fallback, and no mobile overflow.
acceptance_criteria: PQC validator passes for this packet.
Live smoke runs after deployment before Done.

criteria: Affected route and role are limited to Rabbi/provider review/view-as One Time workspace.
Current-state code inspection identified exact offending provider.html branches.
No external writes or provider setup changes are authorized.
